selection_notes.scope: One overview reference for each of the 23 nonblank initiative tags in the current dataset. Individual study citations remain in the database.
selection_notes.BRI: Use the source preprint DOI. Crossref lists The Brazilian Reproducibility Initiative as first author, followed by individual authors; preserve that authorship.
selection_notes.RP:P: Preserve the published group author Open Science Collaboration.
selection_notes.Soto et al LOPPRP: Christopher J. Soto is the sole author; do not add et al.
selection_notes.EROE: Publisher lists Nature Human Behaviour volume 9, pages 316–330 (2025), despite first online publication in November 2024.
selection_notes.XPHIR: Use journal issue year 2021, volume 12(1), pages 9–44; first online publication was in 2018.
selection_notes.ML1: Include subtitle supplied separately in Crossref metadata.
selection_notes.SPRRR: Use the special-issue editorial specified in previous_replication_initiatives.csv; include subtitle from Crossref.
selection_notes.RRR: Use the peer-reviewed introduction to the series, rather than selecting one of the seven individual RRR papers represented in the dataset.
selection_notes.3ie: No single umbrella research paper was provided by the initiatives CSV. Cite the official Replication Paper Series index with corporate author and no invented publication date.
selection_notes.DataReplicada: Use the official launch article (post 81), dated December 9, 2019, by Joe & Leif (Joseph P. Simmons and Leif D. Nelson). Individual posts 82–97 are linked from the article and represented in the dataset.
selection_notes.L2R:Marsden2018: Dataset source column explicitly names Marsden et al. (2018), Language Learning, Appendix S2; DOI resolves to the narrative and systematic review.
